issues.problem: The counterexample does not state the printed hypothesis it must satisfy, 'Cauchy-complete' (DEC-31). Formally it refutes only 'GH + s ≥ 1 ⇒ regular part future complete'. The stated reason is sound: the scaffold has no DEC-31 predicate for singular E0-manifolds. Causal.Flat.IsCauchyComplete exists only for flat spacetimes, and on Reg{tau<0} it should fail because of the punctured plane. The omission is disclosed, and a question is raised to the author, who named this counterexample in DEC-77. Even so, the cheap formal half is not proved: that {tau = -1} is a Cauchy surface of {tau<0}.
issues.fix: Optionally prove (CE e0PastHalf).IsCauchySurface (paperInY '' {w | w.1 = -1}) (Causal.Causality.IsCauchySurface), so that only the length-metric completeness remains in prose. Keep the question to the author about defining the DEC-31 predicate for E0-manifolds.
